name: Shoujo no Michikusa ~Maigo no Koneko-chan~
original_name: しょうじょのみちくさ～まいごの子猫ちゃん～
source:
Tama dresses always in cat style and really likes it.
One day, she goes to a supermarket with her mother.
However, that shop is not an ordinary supermarket; in fact,
it is a very dangerous place for a cute Lolita girl like her.

Tama happens to lose sight of her mother and gets lost.
She starts looking for her mother.
Then, the dangerous part of the supermarket attacks her.
In the food court...
In the bathroom...
In the pet shop...
And when she finally finds her mother...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036837.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Tama总是穿猫风格的衣服，而且非常喜欢。
有一天，她和妈妈一起去了一家超市。
不过，那家店可不是普通的超市，而是一家普通的超市。事实上，
对于像她这样可爱的洛丽塔女孩来说，这是一个非常危险的地方。

小玉碰巧看不见她的母亲并迷路了。
她开始寻找她的母亲。
然后，超市的危险部分袭击了她。
在美食广场…
在浴室里…
在宠物店里…
当她终于找到她的母亲时……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE036837.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
